description_excerpt: About The Role As an Executive, Supply Planning, you are at the heart of DKSH's supply chain operations, ensuring product availability and on-time delivery that directly supports customer satisfaction and business performance. Through precise demand forecasting, inventory optimization, and cross-functional planning, you enable the organization to operate efficiently, reduce risk, and sustain growth. What You Will Deliver • Manage the purchase requisition and purchase order (PO) process end to end, ensuring full compliance with company policies and driving timely, accurate order fulfillment.…
